scene.speaker: astrid
scene.bubble: Street rules: stop, look, listen… and cross with the green light. Safety first, explorers!

words.clue: It has four wheels and a horn. Beep beep!
It is big and carries many people.
It has two wheels and you pedal.
Cars and buses go on it.

activities.title: Match the rule with the reason.

pairs.left: Wear a helmet on your bike.

activities.title: Listen on the street. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.script: Astrid: We're going to the shop. Street rules, Tomás! … Tomas: Stop at the corner… look left, look right! … Astrid: The light is red. We wait. … Tomas: Now it's green! We cross. … Astrid: Look, a big yellow lorry! And two motorbikes. … Tomas: The shop is next to the bakery. Mmm, bread! … Astrid: We buy milk and eggs… and one little bread for the walk home. … Tomas: Street rules AND bread. Perfect trip!

data.text: Play the crossing game: one is the traffic light (says red! green!), the other walks or stops. Then swap. Always look both ways!

activities.title: Look at A and B. What is different?
activities.instructions: Look at picture A and picture B. Find the 11 differences and tell your partner about them.

homework.prompt: Write 3 street rules in English and draw a traffic light. Teach them to someone at home!

outcomes.puede: Understand short simple dialogues about family, school, animals, food (Cambridge Starters Listening parts 1–4).
Answer picture-prompted questions; describe a picture in simple sentences.
Read 2–3-sentence texts; match pictures to words and short captions.
Copy words and complete short sentences (Starters Reading/Writing parts).
~450 words (Starters wordlist); Present simple, present continuous (limited), there is/are, like + -ing.

gramatica: Wh- questions: Where is…? How do I get to…?
